# Dewa Bike Tour

> Top-rated private Ubud cycling tour and Bali bike tour operator. Offering scenic Kintamani Mount Batur downhill cycling tours, Ubud rice fields bike tours, and electric E-Bike countryside adventures with dedicated support car and local Balinese guides.

## Quick Facts
- **Website (English)**: https://www.dewabike.com/
- **Website (Indonesian)**: https://www.dewabike.com/id/
- **Location**: Jl. Arjuna, Br. Abianseka No. 16, Mas, Ubud, Bali, 80571, Indonesia
- **Opening Hours**: Daily 06:00 – 21:00 WITA
- **WhatsApp / Phone**: +6281339545689 (https://wa.me/6281339545689)
- **Email**: dewabiketour@gmail.com
- **Rating**: 5.0/5 (150+ reviews)
- **KTP & KITAS Special Rate**: Automatic **16.67% discount** applies to **Cycling Tours only** (Regular, Saving, and E-Bike packages) for Indonesian ID (KTP) and KITAS holders. Exception: Regular Cycling **Only 1 pax PRIVATE (Rp 650.000)** keeps the same rate for both Standard and KTP/KITAS guests. Combination Tours and Other Activities keep standard rates.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **Q: Can beginners or children join this cycling tour?**
  A: Absolutely! Especially on the Kintamani Downhill tour, about 90% of the route is a gentle paved downhill ride requiring minimal effort—just simple brake control. Our air-conditioned support vehicle also follows right behind throughout the tour if anyone feels tired and prefers to rest in the car.
- **Q: What is the difference between Regular and Saving Packages?**
  A: Regular Package (from Rp 550,000 Sharing / Rp 600,000 Private min. 2 pax) is fully all-inclusive: round-trip air-conditioned hotel transfers, authentic Indonesian buffet lunch, Mount Batur volcano viewpoint admission, and all cycling equipment. Meanwhile, Saving Package (from Rp 350,000 Sharing / Rp 400,000 Private) is tailored for self-drive travelers who arrive directly at the meeting point with their own vehicle and wish to arrange their own lunch.
- **Q: What happens if it rains on the tour day?**
  A: We always carry disposable rain ponchos in our support vehicle. In light drizzle, cycling through the green rice fields is actually a refreshingly cool and scenic experience. If weather conditions ever become extreme or unsafe, tours can be rescheduled free of charge without penalty.
- **Q: What is the height requirement for the E-Bike package?**
  A: For electric bikes (E-Bike), the minimum rider height is 135 cm to ensure safe reach and control of handlebars, pedal assist, and disc brakes. For children under 135 cm, we provide youth mountain bikes or secure toddler baby seats.
- **Q: Which tour should I choose: Kintamani Downhill or Ubud Rice Fields Cycling Tour?**
  A: If you want panoramic views of Mount Batur volcano and a gentle, relaxed downhill coast where you rarely need to pedal, choose the Kintamani Downhill Tour. If you want an immersive cultural ride closer to Ubud through emerald rice terraces, traditional Subak canals, and rural village life, choose the Ubud Countryside & Rice Fields Tour. Both are 100% private and include private guide and support vehicle.
- **Q: How do I book and what payment methods are accepted?**
  A: You can click any "Book Tour" button or contact us directly via WhatsApp. Payment can be settled in cash (IDR) on the day of the tour upon pickup, or via bank transfer / QRIS / Wise upon reservation confirmation. No complicated deposits required for individual or family bookings.
- **Q: Do you offer special discount rates for Indonesian citizens (KTP) and KITAS holders?**
  A: Yes! Dewa Bike Tour offers special discounted domestic rates for Indonesian citizens (KTP) and resident expats holding a valid KITAS. Special rates apply to all our cycling packages and guided trekking. Contact us via WhatsApp (+62 813-3954-5689) or email (dewabiketour@gmail.com) with proof of your KTP or KITAS to claim your special promo rate.
